column5: Refuses a promise precisely to keep the licensed multi-dragline split reachable without breaking a contract
Lays down the binding consumer prohibition -- what the clause enforces is the absence of a promise
Defines reorder pairwise, which is the standing rule every migration policy is then measured against
Substitutes which rule actually binds pardosa on the migration path, replacing total order in the invariant list
Decides what the clause states normatively and what it withholds, and points rather than restates so one fact lives in one place
Fixes what pardosa promises at all: replay determinism is contracted because rebuilding a projection twice is the point of the model
Sets when each clause starts binding, and rules that a refusal's marker attaches to its force rather than its deletion
Allocates the rationale between spec and ADR -- which document carries which kind of statement
Makes link integrity the promised invariant, bounded by three explicit non-claims that later rulings derive from
Spans rule and information flow; higher-leverage taken -- the tier-1 invariant binding from 0.5.1, with the anchor gap named as a third value
Decides what the 1.0 walk surface exposes: one method with strict semantics, the permissive variant removed
Makes the invariant-breaking configuration inexpressible rather than merely defaulted off
Binds every ordinary path to refuse, and confines entry to an explicitly-named election at the call site
States the per-artefact per-generation anchor obligation an operator must satisfy and the spec cannot check
Structures how the claim reaches a stranger: two scoped claims with qualifiers, never one quotable aggregate
Fixes what the schema covers -- T taken whole -- which is the definitional rule every descriptor ruling then builds on
Makes the enum-of-variants shape pardosa's own taught concept, changing the language a consumer models in
Refuses the affordance the new vocabulary makes tempting, blocking the inference where it now arises
Binds pardosa from 0.5.1 against ever admitting a heterogeneous artefact, for a reader who cannot see it in the bytes
Records which document owns which half, so the seam most likely to be described twice is named once
Removes the option to ship a self-undescribing artefact, making the descriptor unconditional
Fixes what information the descriptor carries, and therefore what a non-Rust reader can decode
Chooses the vocabulary the description is expressed in: a closed constructor set, not a Rust parser
Defines the two-layer verification that damps descriptor drift -- mechanical completeness plus the clean-room rebuild
Decides where the descriptor lives and therefore where a reader must look, once per artefact on either adapter
Fixes which document each hash factor versions, so the composition is not misread as crossing the boundary
Makes identity a pure function of the descriptor, closing the drift between two vocabularies
Fixes what identity comprises -- shape plus name, a component never a key, with no registry to adjudicate
Adds direction to a value that previously only distinguished, letting a reader ask which came first
Places the version inside the descriptor, so identity still determines the description
Converts consumer-declared trust into a mechanical monotonicity assertion at the one observable transition
States the non-claim positively so a stranger does not read identity strength from the neighbouring chain
Collapses two renderings into one so the public surface cannot present a shape twice and drift
Fixes equality as the only comparison and routes every schema change through the exclusively-held migration path
Places the refusal without across-major permanence, so 1.0 does not foreclose the 2.0 design space
Binds the whole clause family from one marker at 0.5.1, closing the window where a rule refuses without saying why
Splits one conflated value into two type-level conditions so the diagnostic stops asserting the wrong cause
Drops the attribute whose purpose is growing an enum at a minor, closing that hole in the freeze
Inverts the default so every public enum is major-locked and openness must be earned by designation
Shapes the error surface so a caller must match both remedies rather than re-fold them behind one constructor
Applies the one-word-per-concept rule, assigning ownership of the word and renaming the other claimants
Sets the naming shape for the condition family: name the property, never the mechanism that detected it
Sets how long the naming decision waits -- deferred until its dependency lands, so sibling nouns are chosen together
Separates what the caller can always be told from what may be unknowable, rather than folding the gap
Binds every event-yielding read path on every adapter, requiring the symmetry be structural rather than incidental
Constrains the permitted shape of the consumer's root type, making the event kind structural rather than conventional
Removes the per-message carrier, so a fact true once per artefact is stated once rather than on every event
Mandates variants the consumer must declare, a standing constraint on every consumer's event enum frozen at 1.0
